reasoning: This commit ("feature: allow spoon to do static imports for methods and fields (#1040)") introduced the buggy logic in MinimalImportScanner.java that the fix directly modifies: the `Set<String> qualifiedNameTokens` collection populated by walking up packages with `packParent.getParent() != null` (without checking for the top-level package boundary), and the subsequent loop checking every token in the set against field/method/local variable names instead of only the last (most specific) token. This flawed package-walking and token-matching logic is exactly what causes the reported bug where a private static field with a name matching a package/class segment incorrectly triggers/misses static import decisions. The fix commit changes the Set to a LinkedList, adds a top-level-package termination check, and changes the check to only use the last token — directly undoing the faulty logic introduced in adb2fd7420b3.
